title: Afghan–Maratha War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Afghan–Maratha War", at revision 1370427150, opens: "The Afghan–Maratha War was fought between the Afghan Empire under Ahmad Shah Durrani and the Maratha Empire and the Sikh Confederacy between 1758 and 1761. It took place in north-west India, primarily the region around Delhi and Punjab." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q127257738, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "18th-century conflict between Afghans and Maratha–Sikh alliance". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
